quality.scope: Coherent rank-two S2 core, arbitrary complex output isometry and loss dilation. No arbitrary-rank or displaced input claim. Frozen before quality draws.
quality.experiment_rule: 0x92002000 + case_index; sector=0; record=global row; purposes 1 waiting and 2 detector
quality.metrics: Per new case: complete PNR TV upper via empirical TV concentration plus analytic target tail; independently validated pilot-selected event lower; separate click TV upper and lower. Recompute all 12 historical88 PNR upper/lower pairs in the same48-event family. No tail conditioning, sample deletion or refill.
quality.assumptions: Nominal concentration assumes iid within each dataset. Injective Philox addresses remove deterministic stream reuse but are not a proof of iid. Floating numerical reference errors are not fully interval-certified. Each failed trajectory is a separate target-zero outcome.
